description: Roster-wide conversion index. Setting threat tier is distinct from Lancer NPC tier. Core stats follow selected official Lancer NPC class/tier. Tactical size is the proposed map-footprint override recorded in the conversion master.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Mobility denial; sensor obstruction; suppression of mechanical targets

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Environmental pattern reproduction; purpose undetermined

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Transport and placement of defensive barriers
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use area-denial/obstruction baseline; deployed barriers use normal deployable/terrain rules.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Area suppression; escort fire; denial of exposed routes

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Threat assessment; recognition of Tank configurations
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use target acquisition/fire-control baseline; relay consequences remain limited to documented effects.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Fragment aggregation and distributed locomotion; purpose undetermined

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: On-site fabrication; production of replacement components
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use fabrication/tooling baseline; build/repair effects require time and compatible materials.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Waste routing; deposition of industrial residue
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use support baseline; influence on nearby units only applies where lore supports coordination or maintenance.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Production of biomechanical fibers; repair-tissue supply
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use deployable/area-denial baseline; placed material is limited to documented output and does not multiply indefinitely.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Route marking; passive pursuit guidance
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use infiltration/precision-strike baseline; do not turn exposed-component targeting into automatic destruction.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Sensor disruption; targeting interference; short-range area suppression
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use controller baseline; acoustic interference calls for a save and affects only the documented sensor/communication channels.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Equipment disabling; extraction-line interference
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use close ambush baseline; cable/joint interference requires a hit and should not disable a Tank automatically.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Long-range bombardment; area denial; destruction of fortified positions
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use high-tier artillery baseline; bombardment uses explicit telegraph/target area to remain fair and readable.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Transport of defensive panels and combat units; rapid establishment of protected corridors
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use barrier/transport baseline; deploying cargo consumes an action and creates a defined terrain or unit effect.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Field assembly; tissue growth; restoration of disabled monsters
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use repair/field-engineering baseline; reconstitution requires time, energy and compatible feedstock.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Monster-core processing; power distribution; industrial defense support
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use defensive/power-support baseline; electrical discharge is a bounded triggered hazard, not passive area damage every round.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Long-range target acquisition; multi-unit coordination; pursuit-network management
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Strategic sensor/relay trait; gains information/coordination only for allied units that could receive its signal.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Localized multi-system interference; distributed site control; purpose undetermined
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Site-interference profile; effects are confined to an explicit area and selected systems, with visual observation still possible where lore says so.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Recovery of disabled machines; removal of major obstructions; heavy industrial towing
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Heavy mass/route alteration uses explicit map features; do not add damage merely for existing on the map.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Precision anti-Tank fire; long-range route denial; target selection
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use high-tier precision-fire baseline; long range does not imply unlimited map range or guaranteed hits.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Saturation attack; mobile area denial; pursuit-route interdiction
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use high-tier artillery/deployment baseline; multiple ordnance effects remain limited to the class action economy.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Heavy assault; mobility-module destruction; denial of extraction
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use high-tier heavy assault baseline; mobility-module damage is a special effect after a hit, not automatic instant disablement.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Long-range restraint; pursuit; extraction-route interdiction
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use high-tier long-range precision baseline; line of sight, firing position and telegraphing remain important.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Sensor disruption; false-contact generation; concealment support
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Decoy and sensor-confusion trait; deception can be checked against visual confirmation or independent sensors.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Mobile micro-unit fabrication; continuous combat-unit production; forward deployment support; local material processing; swarm replenishment
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use swarm/controller baseline. Needle Spider production is capped by a simple encounter limit and action cost; never use unlimited reinforcements.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Mobile fire support; sustained suppression; anti-Tank skirmishing; extraction-route interdiction
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use sustained-fire skirmisher baseline; two rifles are represented by the normal Barrage/action economy, not two extra independent turns.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Suicide attack; elevated ambush; Tank cockpit breach; pilot elimination
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use Assassin baseline. Its single-use cockpit latch is a custom trait: successful attachment starts a timed removal/breach procedure; pilot death is never automatic from the damage value alone.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Tank-origin inference; reinforced-cable severance; direct cable ascent; Flock infiltration
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use stealth/infiltration baseline. Cable severance is a specific objective action with progress/interrupt conditions, not a free attack that automatically destroys a cable.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Heavy-material recovery; bulk industrial transport; armored deployment carrier; rapid movement of smaller factory units
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use heavy hauler baseline; cargo and mobile-corridor effects are objective/terrain interactions, not extra weapon attacks.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Unknown; possible observation, reconnaissance, or an unconfirmed special-purpose role
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Exception: do not assign an ordinary Lancer NPC class/tier or combat statistics yet. The lore states its capabilities and durability are unknown; present it as an investigation/withdrawal encounter until evidence supports a stat block.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Armored pursuit; breach assault; continuous close-range engagement; area denial
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use heavy armored close-assault baseline; pursuit/area denial is a trait, and armor remains the official class value unless playtest calls for a deliberate exception.

lore_to_mechanics.documented_function: Ultra-long-range artillery; anti-Tank fire; indirect-fire area denial; scout-coordinated targeting
lore_to_mechanics.conversion_note: Use high-tier artillery baseline. Long-distance attacks require a defined off-map firing solution, warning/impact procedure and mission counterplay.
